title: Yoshirt
role: Founder and president, product and interface design
body: Launched November 2014 with NEFF as the first brand on the platform. Pick a shirt, hoodie, tank or socks, drop your photos and graphics on it, buy it. Printed on the fabric before it's sewn, made in the US, at your door in a few days.
I owned the product and the interface. My cofounders came from Apple and from DC Shoes and RVCA. We raised a $1.1M seed in 2015 from Kleiner Perkins, Pritzker Group, Resolute and MESA.
Apple featured us at WWDC for Apple Pay. 500k+ downloads. Partnerships with NEFF, Agenda, Known and more. I ran it through 2017.
